tagline: Up a long ridge of windblown dust above the flat Delta.
intro: From the Helena Bridge over the Mississippi the parkway heads north onto Crowley's Ridge and runs as a narrow two-lane road through the St. Francis National Forest, past Storm Creek Lake. Then it takes up the ridge towns one by one, Marianna and Forrest City, Jonesboro and Paragould, and crosses into the Missouri Bootheel to finish at Malden.

The ridge is loess, windblown soil piled up between the old channels of the Mississippi and the Ohio, and it stands well clear of the flat Delta around it. The road along it is a patchwork of highways, county roads and city streets. The ridge's high point in Arkansas is Legacy Mountain, at the county solid waste site south of Jonesboro.

moments.title: Helena
moments.text: King Biscuit Time, a blues show that went on the air here in 1941 once a flour company agreed to sponsor it, is the longest-running daily radio program in the country.

moments.title: Parkin Archeological State Park
moments.text: A palisaded village stood where the St. Francis and Tyronza rivers meet from about 1350 to 1650, and many archeologists take it for part of Casqui, the province de Soto visited in 1542.

moments.title: Crowley's Ridge State Park
moments.text: On Benjamin Crowley's old homesite the parkway runs right through the park, among stone and log buildings the Civilian Conservation Corps put up in the 1930s.
